- A lead launch accepts the three CLI options and ignores them; nothing refuses them.
lessons: When an amendment widens what every launch reads, a shared-folder "does not matter" case turns red. td-5 caught one in S4. Before briefing such an amendment, grep the existing cases for that folder.
